name: UCR Time Series Classification Archive
description: The UCR Time Series Classification Archive is the gold-standard benchmark repository for time-series classification. Maintained by researchers at UC Riverside and University of East Anglia, it features 128 standardized univariate time-series datasets spanning sensor data, ECG/EEG, motion capture, audio spectrograms, and simulated physics.

publisher.name: University of California, Riverside & University of East Anglia

license.name: Unspecified by Source (UCR / UEA Academic Research Archive)
license.notes: Hosted at timeseriesclassification.com for academic research benchmarking and reproducibility. The archive aggregates diverse time-series datasets from various domain donors without an explicit universal commercial use authorization; commercial usability is cataloged as unknown.
